In 1915, Elder James E. Talmage taught that feet-dusting is “employed only under unusual and extreme conditions as the Spirit of the Lord may direct” (James E. Talmage,Jesus the Christ[Salt Lake City: Deseret News Press, 1915], 345–46). Missionaries no longer shake the dust from their feet unless authorized by their mission president.
